PART V  Medical Nutrition Therapy
Hypoglycemia
A low blood glucose, or hypoglycemia (or insulin reaction), 
is a common side effect of insulin therapy, although individu-
als taking insulin secretagogues also can be affected. Auto-
nomic symptoms arise from the action of the autonomic 
nervous system and are often the first signs of mild hypogly-
cemia. Adrenergic symptoms include shakiness, sweating, pal-
pitations, anxiety, and hunger. Neuroglycopenic symptoms,
